settings.heading: Three seconds, head to toe.
settings.content: No 7-step routine. Just warm, press, and glow.

settings.title: Warm a little
settings.text: Scoop a pea-sized amount and rub between fingertips until it melts.

settings.title: Press it in
settings.text: Smooth over damp skin — face, lips, elbows, anywhere dry.

settings.title: Glow on
settings.text: Morning, night, or whenever skin asks. A little goes far.

settings.heading: Get the most from your jar

settings.a: Applying after a shower helps the balm trap that moisture in — you'll need even less.
Start tiny. Tallow is concentrated; too much can feel greasy.
